Explorer fixtures

inventory.json defines 29 owned objects per cluster, including the kubesift-explorer namespace and widgets.explorer.kubesift.dev CRD. scripts/dev-clusters.sh --explorer checks collisions before applying to kind-dev-local-a/b only. It never replaces shop/billing or creates clusters.

BusyBox 1.37.0 is pinned to sha256:a7dbc319b1438115a207e11930dc4bb3e643dcb3ec0bdd694bb36cd8fad289ec. Heartbeats occur every 30 seconds. missing-image, missing-setting, failed-job and pending-storage are intentional failures; CronJob is suspended. Secrets are fake. A/B same-pod markers are local-a and local-b. Broader fixtures do not imply product browsing coverage.

Phase 1C.2 adds init-evidence (completed init container), web-lookalike (Deployment label match without controller ownership), and scaled-zero (zero desired replicas).

The pod-reader ServiceAccount can only get/list Pods in this namespace. Short-lived token kubeconfigs belong in ignored .local storage, never here.
